title: style-review: calibrate variable-declaration order (AA0021) to info
summary: The variable-declaration-order rule (AA0021) severity is calibrated down from minor to info level in quality reviews because it is redundant with the CodeCop analyzer.
key_points: AA0021 rule severity changes from minor to info to stop competing with substantive style checks
Rule is purely analyzer-redundant and already covered by CodeCop
Aligns with similar analyzer-redundant rules (AA0248, AA0074) already at info level
Online evaluation showed false positive rate, justifying the downgrade
Text-only change to severity calibration documentation
